articles.title: Why 'unretired' seniors are picking up gig work to pay the bills
articles.mainIdea: Why 'unretired' seniors are picking up gig work to pay the bills
articles.summary: Associated Press: Why 'unretired' seniors are picking up gig work to pay the bills. Before Stu Goldberg begins his night shift driving for Uber, he pulls out a notebook to read a handwritten list of reminders. With a Ph.D in neuropsychology and decades of experience running his own business, Goldberg, 74, didn't picture chauffeuring strangers around when he retired. Goldberg is one of a growing number of Americans who have “unretired” in recent years.
